remarks: Welcome to this charming condominium featuring a bright, open concept layout designed for comfortable living and effortless entertaining. The spacious living and dining area flows seamlessly into the kitchen, creating an inviting atmosphere filled with natural light.The generously sized bedroom offers a peaceful retreat, while the well appointed bathroom provides both style and functionality. Step outside to your private patio, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee, relaxing with a book, or dining al fresco. Whether you are a first time buyer, looking to downsize, or searching for a low maintenance home, this condominium offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and modern living in a great location in Westport.
